bridge: chart scanning (finding patterns across ranking samples)

definition.en: 扫榜 (sǎo bǎng, 'chart scanning') means reading ranking and recommendation samples for repeated patterns such as genre, protagonist setup and opening angle. Oh Story's scan workflow treats a single title's rank as a lead, not a validated market trend, and distinguishes observations supported across samples from ideas needing further checks.
definition.zh: 扫榜是阅读榜单与推荐样本，寻找题材、主角人设、开局切入点等重复模式。Oh Story 的扫榜流程把单本排名当作线索，而不是已验证的市场趋势，并区分跨样本支持的观察与仍需验证的想法。

in_practice.en: `/story-long-scan` prefers platform collectors when available, then user-supplied ranking data; built-in knowledge is a last-resort fallback that must be labeled. The report records evidence, risks and next validation steps. Missing or small samples cannot justify high-confidence feasibility claims. Sources (reviewed 2026-09-12): [Purpose and evidence hierarchy](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-scan/SKILL.md#L44-L170) · [Report and uncertainty rules](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-scan/SKILL.md#L235-L292).
in_practice.zh: `/story-long-scan` 优先使用可用的平台采集脚本，其次使用用户提供的榜单数据；内置知识是必须标明的最后降级来源。报告记录证据、风险与下一步验证动作；缺少数据或样本过少时，不能据此给出高可行性结论。 源码依据（核对于 2026-09-12）：[目标与数据优先级](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-scan/SKILL.md#L44-L170) · [报告与不确定性规则](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-scan/SKILL.md#L235-L292)。

bridge: deconstruction (analyzing a reference text into reusable story components)

definition.en: 拆文 (chāi wén) is structured analysis of a reference work: outline rhythm, plot modules, emotional beats, character functions, style and setting. Oh Story organizes the findings as reusable reference material for later writing. They are analytical interpretations, not a guarantee that a new work will reproduce the source’s market performance.
definition.zh: 拆文是对参考作品进行结构化分析，包括大纲节奏、剧情模块、情绪节拍、角色功能、文风与设定。Oh Story 把分析结果整理为供后续写作使用的参考资料。这些结果是分析性解释，不保证新作品能复现原作的市场表现。

in_practice.en: `/story-long-analyze` begins with a three-chapter preview and pauses to ask whether to continue, unless the creator already requested a complete run. In that case it writes the preview and continues without another prompt. Its staged outputs include an overview, analysis report, style notes, chapters, characters, plot material and settings; the output templates define what each stage records. Sources (reviewed 2026-09-12): [Staged analysis](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-analyze/SKILL.md#L139-L149) · [Output templates](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-analyze/references/output-templates.md#L63-L109).
in_practice.zh: `/story-long-analyze` 先分析前三章并生成预览，再询问是否继续；若创作者已明确要求完整拆解，则仍产出预览，但不停下询问。阶段化产物包括概要、拆文报告、文风、章节、角色、剧情素材与设定；输出模板规定各阶段记录哪些内容。 源码依据（核对于 2026-09-12）：[阶段化拆文](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-analyze/SKILL.md#L139-L149) · [输出模板](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-analyze/references/output-templates.md#L63-L109)。

bridge: de-AI editing / de-slop (bounded editing of formulaic prose patterns)

definition.en: 去AI味 (qù AI wèi) refers to editing formulaic or repetitive prose patterns associated with model output. In Oh Story it combines pattern checks with limited revisions that preserve plot, characters and timeline. Deterministic checks can identify specified patterns; they cannot establish who authored a text or guarantee a detector score.
definition.zh: 去AI味是对常与模型输出相关的套式表达、重复模式进行编辑。在 Oh Story 中，它把模式检查与有限改写结合起来，同时保留剧情、人设和时间线。确定性检查能识别指定模式，但不能证明文本作者身份，也不能保证任何检测分数。

in_practice.en: `/story-deslop` runs `check-ai-patterns.js` and `check-degeneration.js`, makes bounded minimal edits and scans again. Blocking degeneration such as unrecoverable truncation is not repaired by polishing wording; the workflow directs it back to regeneration. Sources (reviewed 2026-09-12): [Editing boundaries](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-deslop/SKILL.md#L21-L49) · [Checks and degeneration](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-deslop/SKILL.md#L186-L197).
in_practice.zh: `/story-deslop` 运行 `check-ai-patterns.js` 与 `check-degeneration.js`，按边界做最小修改后复扫。不可恢复截断等阻断级退化不能靠润色修复，流程要求回到重新生成。 源码依据（核对于 2026-09-12）：[编辑边界](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-deslop/SKILL.md#L21-L49) · [检查与退化信号](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-deslop/SKILL.md#L186-L197)。

bridge: motion comic / animated drama (rather than live-action short drama)

definition.en: 漫剧 (màn jù) is a short serialized drama told through animated or comic-style imagery rather than live-action footage. In Drama Skills, an accepted production profile is recorded for the relevant later stages. Creators can enter through an existing screenplay, visual design, storyboard or prompt task without fabricating missing upstream work.
definition.zh: 漫剧是用动画或漫画风格画面、而非实拍影像讲述的短篇连续剧。在 Drama Skills 中，已接受的制作形态档案会被记录下来，供相关下游阶段读取。创作者可以从已有剧本、视觉设定、分镜或提示词任务直接进入，不必为了补齐流水线虚构上游文档。

in_practice.en: Drama Skills maintains up to five kinds of creator-readable Markdown documents per episode as needed, rather than requiring exactly five files for every episode. Frozen-keyframe prompts and continuity-lock phrases specify and mechanically check selected constraints; they do not guarantee cross-shot media consistency. Sources (reviewed 2026-09-12): [Creator-first workflow](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama/references/creator-workflow.md#L3-L34) · [Continuity-lock obligations](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama-assets/references/continuity-lock.md#L22-L49).
in_practice.zh: Drama Skills 按需维护每集最多五类、创作者可直接阅读的 Markdown 文档，而不是要求每集恰好五份文件。冻结关键帧提示词与连续性锁用于写明并机械检查部分约束，不保证生成媒体跨镜头一致。 源码依据（核对于 2026-09-12）：[按需创作流程](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama/references/creator-workflow.md#L3-L34) · [连续性锁义务](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama-assets/references/continuity-lock.md#L22-L49)。

bridge: golden three chapters (an early-opening analysis checkpoint)

definition.en: 黄金三章 ('golden three chapters') treats the opening three chapters as an early unit for examining a serial's premise, conflict, hooks and emotional payoffs. Oh Story uses that unit as a preview checkpoint before optional full deconstruction. It is a writing convention and workflow boundary, not proof that recommendations, retention or commercial success are decided in exactly three chapters.
definition.zh: 黄金三章把开篇三章作为观察连载作品设定、冲突、钩子与爽点的早期单元。Oh Story 把它用作完整拆文之前的预览检查点。这是写作惯例与流程边界，不证明平台推荐、读者留存或商业成败恰好由三章决定。

in_practice.en: Stage 1 of `/story-long-analyze` produces the opening preview and asks whether to continue, unless the creator already requested a complete run. In that case it writes the preview and continues without stopping. The templates record chapter-level hooks, conflict, pacing and payoff analysis rather than presenting a market-outcome forecast. Sources (reviewed 2026-09-12): [Preview checkpoint](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-analyze/SKILL.md#L139-L149) · [Three-chapter analysis](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-analyze/references/output-templates.md#L77-L142). For a creator’s new serial opening rather than reference analysis, the [novel-opening guide](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/novel-opening) demonstrates local payoff and a continuing question across an original three-chapter plan.
in_practice.zh: `/story-long-analyze` 第一阶段产出开篇预览，再询问是否继续；若创作者已明确要求完整拆解，则仍产出预览，但不停下询问。模板记录逐章钩子、冲突、节奏与爽点分析，而不是预测市场结果。 源码依据（核对于 2026-09-12）：[预览检查点](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-analyze/SKILL.md#L139-L149) · [三章拆解字段](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-analyze/references/output-templates.md#L77-L142)。 若要写自己的连载开头，而非分析参考作品，见[小说开篇指南](https://zenstory.ai/oh-story/novel-opening)：用原创三章方案说明先兑现什么，再接什么问题。

bridge: payoff beat (a planned moment of emotional satisfaction)

definition.en: 爽点 (shuǎng diǎn) is a planned payoff beat: a moment intended to satisfy an expectation created by earlier conflict or setup. Oh Story records the intended payoff in chapter planning and examines payoff patterns when analyzing reference works. This is a craft construct, not a guarantee that readers will feel satisfied or remain with a serial.
definition.zh: 爽点是规划中的情绪兑现点：用某个时刻回应前文冲突或铺垫建立的期待。Oh Story 在章节规划中记录预期爽点，也在拆文时分析参考作品的爽点模式。这是创作设计，不保证读者一定满意或持续追读。

in_practice.en: The long-form outline-contract checker requires a 爽点 field. Analysis templates separately describe the source chapter’s payoff and setup; structural validation checks that the planning field exists, not that the scene is emotionally effective. Sources (reviewed 2026-09-12): [Required outline fields](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-write/scripts/check-outline-contract.js#L20-L28) · [Payoff analysis](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-analyze/references/output-templates.md#L128-L150).
in_practice.zh: 长篇细纲契约检查器要求包含「爽点」字段。拆文模板则分别描述参考章节的爽点与铺垫；结构校验确认规划字段存在，不确认场景是否真的产生情绪效果。 源码依据（核对于 2026-09-12）：[细纲必填字段](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-write/scripts/check-outline-contract.js#L20-L28) · [爽点分析字段](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-analyze/references/output-templates.md#L128-L150)。

bridge: hook (an opening, ending or paragraph-level reason to keep reading)

definition.en: 钩子 (gōu zi, 'hook') is a device at a chapter boundary or inside a paragraph that invites the reader to continue: an unanswered question, a countdown, a reversal or unfinished dialogue. In serialized web fiction, a chapter-ending hook aims to sustain interest into the next installment, including across a paywalled boundary; it does not guarantee a purchase or continued reading.
definition.zh: 钩子是放在章节边界或段落内部、邀请读者继续往下读的设计，例如未回答的问题、倒计时、反转或尚未接完的对白。在连载网文中，章尾钩子旨在把兴趣带入下一章，也可能面对付费章节的门槛；它不保证读者付费或继续阅读。

in_practice.en: Oh Story documents 13 chapter-ending forms, 7 chapter-opening forms and paragraph-level hooks. Its long-form chapter-blueprint checker requires a 章首钩子 (opening hook) field; a structural check verifies the field, not its literary effectiveness. Sources (reviewed 2026-09-12): [Hook forms](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/README.md#L376-L382) · [Blueprint fields](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-write/scripts/check-outline-contract.js#L21-L26).
in_practice.zh: Oh Story 的参考文档列出章尾钩子 13 式、章首钩子 7 式和段落级钩子。长篇章节蓝图的结构检查器要求包含「章首钩子」字段；结构检查验证字段是否存在，不验证文学效果。 源码依据（核对于 2026-09-12）：[钩子分类](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/README.md#L376-L382) · [蓝图字段](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/skills/story-long-write/scripts/check-outline-contract.js#L21-L26)。

definition.en: 套路 (tào lù) can be translated as 'trope' or 'formula'. Oh Story frames it with the motto 套路 = 确定性的情绪满足: the craft aim is to understand the emotional payoff a familiar pattern is designed to deliver. This is the project's writing framework, not a guarantee that every reader will respond in the same way.
definition.zh: 套路可以译为 trope 或 formula。Oh Story 用「套路 = 确定性的情绪满足」表达其创作框架：理解一种熟悉的叙事模式试图兑现什么情绪。这里是项目的方法论表述，不是每位读者都会产生相同反应的保证。

in_practice.en: The README connects this framing to four practices: reverse-engineering successful works, recombining plot modules, managing context and state in layers, and keeping a human in the loop. Sources (reviewed 2026-09-12): [Project method](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/README.md#L13-L23).
in_practice.zh: README 将这套框架连接到四项实践：爆款逆向、剧情模块化重组、上下文状态分层管理和人机协同。 源码依据（核对于 2026-09-12）：[项目核心思路](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/oh-story-claudecode/blob/aa3574fe6887fe1204168167b747d709607e77b6/README.md#L13-L23)。

bridge: episode map (a series-level handoff plan for later writing)

definition.en: 分集地图 (fēn jí dì tú, 'episode map') records each episode's incoming state, objective and opposition, turn, local result, information release, outgoing pressure, precise handoff, continuity changes and open questions. In Drama Skills it gives later writing sessions an explicit handoff plan; it cannot by itself guarantee that a long series will not drift.
definition.zh: 分集地图逐集记录进入状态、目标与阻力、方向性转折、当集结果、信息释放、出去压力、精确交接、连续性变化和未决项。在 Drama Skills 中，它给后续写作会话提供显式交接计划，但不能单独保证长系列绝不跑偏。

in_practice.en: `short-drama-develop` creates or revises an episode map when the creator needs episode planning. Genre and hook references are loaded as needed; a director’s statement is an optional candidate, not a mandatory companion deliverable. Sources (reviewed 2026-09-12): [Episode-map fields](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama-develop/references/episode-design.md#L328-L340) · [Development scope](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama-develop/SKILL.md#L84-L106).
in_practice.zh: `short-drama-develop` 在创作者需要分集规划时创建或修订地图；题材与钩子参考按需加载，导演阐述是可选候选，并非必须配套产出的文档。 源码依据（核对于 2026-09-12）：[分集地图字段](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama-develop/references/episode-design.md#L328-L340) · [开发阶段边界](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama-develop/SKILL.md#L84-L106)。

bridge: director's statement (a candidate visual direction and production profile)

definition.en: 导演阐述 (dǎo yǎn chǎn shù, 'director’s statement') describes project-level visual direction and production constraints. In Drama Skills it starts as a candidate director-brief. It constrains later work only after the creator accepts it and promotes its visual_direction / production_profile into the project's authoritative creative decisions.
definition.zh: 导演阐述描述项目级视觉方向与生产约束。在 Drama Skills 中，它先作为候选文档起草；只有经创作者接受，并把 visual_direction / production_profile 提升为项目生效的创作决策（creator authority）后，才约束下游工作。

in_practice.en: Look Development is an optional branch that can turn an accepted direction into observable text frame specifications before formal storyboarding. These specifications are not proof that rendered images already match the intended look. Sources (reviewed 2026-09-12): [Accepting a director brief](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama-develop/references/director-brief-craft.md#L10-L16) · [Look Development scope](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama/references/look-development.md#L3-L18).
in_practice.zh: Look Development 是可选分支，可在正式分镜前把已接受方向写成可观察的文本风格帧规格。这些规格不证明实际生成画面已经匹配预期风格。 源码依据（核对于 2026-09-12）：[导演阐述生效边界](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama-develop/references/director-brief-craft.md#L10-L16) · [Look Development 边界](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama/references/look-development.md#L3-L18)。

bridge: frozen keyframe prompt (a specification for the visible shot-start frame)

definition.en: In Drama Skills, 冻结关键帧 (dòng jié guān jiàn zhēn, 'frozen keyframe') is a prompt or specification for the visible start of a shot, not proof that an image has already been generated or approved. It inherits screenplay and visual facts; an active continuity-lock phrase must be copied verbatim into the prompt.
definition.zh: 在 Drama Skills 中，冻结关键帧是镜头可见起点的提示词或规格，不等于图片已经生成或审核通过。它继承剧本与视觉设定事实；生效的连续性锁锁面必须原样写进提示词。

in_practice.en: It belongs to storyboarding and describes only its declared boundary, the start by default. An actual image becomes a usable starting-frame reference only after it is generated or supplied and bound as a `REF-` asset. Specifying a lock does not guarantee consistent generated media. Sources (reviewed 2026-09-12): [Storyboard contract](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama-storyboard/SKILL.md#L50-L104) · [Production and reference binding](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama-produce/SKILL.md#L15-L23).
in_practice.zh: 它属于分镜阶段，只描述声明的边界（默认是起点）。真实图片须在生成或提供并绑定为 `REF-` 资产后，才成为可用起始帧参考。写入锁面不保证生成媒体一定保持一致。 源码依据（核对于 2026-09-12）：[分镜契约](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama-storyboard/SKILL.md#L50-L104) · [生产与参考绑定](https://github.com/zenstory-ai/drama-skills/blob/4c40ca6101648579b2455d0c0d890ce701f05173/skills/short-drama-produce/SKILL.md#L15-L23)。
